correctness.rationale: The interval complement identity is exact for all positive real lengths. Equality at 0 and 2π/L yields g equality and two D branches. A second derivative resolves reflection in the direct branch. In the complementary branch the second/fourth Taylor coefficients yield (b-v)4ac(S+3g)=0; positivity forces b=v. Both identities were independently checked symbolically, and direct transform comparisons passed.
